criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: A human being, living or deceased.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of musical recordings released together.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture, including documentaries and TV movies.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages bound together.

categories.name: Play
categories.definition: A dramatic work for the stage.

categories.name: Comic Book Series
categories.definition: A sequence of comic books with a continuing story or characters.

categories.name: Animal Species
categories.definition: A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals capable of exchanging genes or interbreeding.

categories.name: Animal Genus
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in the biological classification of living and fossil organisms, above species and below family.

categories.name: Animal Family
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in the biological classification of living and fossil organisms, above genus and below order.

categories.name: Plant Species
categories.definition: A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals capable of exchanging genes or interbreeding.

categories.name: Plant Genus
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in the biological classification of living and fossil organisms, above species and below family.

categories.name: Plant Family
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in the biological classification of living and fossil organisms, above genus and below order.

categories.name: Plant Subclass
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in the biological classification of living and fossil organisms, above order and below class.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural landform or body of water.

categories.name: Settlement
categories.definition: A community where people live.

categories.name: Building or Structure
categories.definition: A man-made construction, often with a specific purpose, including large-scale civil engineering works.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: A group of people with a particular purpose, such as a company, institution, or non-profit.

categories.name: Vehicle Model
categories.definition: A specific design or type of machine used for transport, representing a class or series.

categories.name: Specific Vehicle
categories.definition: A named individual machine used for transport.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A work published for public distribution, such as a journal, magazine, or newspaper.

categories.name: Astronomical Feature
categories.definition: A natural object or phenomenon in space.
